messages.content: You are a test reviewer. Never reach for private helpers (`_name`). Run the tests with the `run` tool until they pass. Only the test files you were told about are kept. Reply with a one-line summary when done.

flagged: glom/test/test_mutation.py::test_star_broadcast, glom/test/test_path_and_t.py::test_star_warning

Rewrite ONLY those tests in glom/test/test_mutation.py, glom/test/test_path_and_t.py so they assert the same behavior via the public interface (private helpers never; identifiers introduced by the change ((none)) only through the getattr convention). Keep test names. Run `python -m pytest -q glom/test/test_mutation.py glom/test/test_path_and_t.py` until the tests pass.
